caption:
Mortgage rates are still way above last year. 🏠

Freddie Mac says the 30-year fixed averaged 7.18% this week, down slightly from 7.24%.

A year ago it was 6.22%.

On a $300,000 loan, that gap is about $191 more per month in principal and interest, or roughly $2,300 a year (our math).

Are you waiting to buy, or giving up on it?
first_comment: Would you buy at today's rates? 👇
